scripts.build:singlefile: vite build --config vite.singlefile.config.ts --mode singlefile-main && vite build --config vite.singlefile.config.ts --mode singlefile-replay
scripts.screenshot:game-ui: rm -f screenshots/replay-playwright/*Shadow-Dragon-is-in-fog.png && npm run replay:playwright -- --log tests/replay-mapdata/logs/zoo.log --instructions scripts/replay-playwright.instructions.example.json --mark-regex "^Shadow Dragon is in fog$" --output-dir screenshots/replay-playwright && cp "$(find screenshots/replay-playwright -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*Shadow-Dragon-is-in-fog.png' | head -n 1)" screenshots/game_ui.png
